question: Sweden Parliamentary Election: 2nd Place
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Sweden on September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the second-greatest number of seats in the Swedish Parliament (Riksdag) in this election.

If voting in the Swedish parliamentary election does not occur by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The named parties or coalitions will be primarily ranked by the number of seats won in the specified election. If two or more parties are tied on seats, ties will be broken by the total number of valid votes received, with higher vote totals ranking higher. If parties remain tied, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the listed party abbreviations. This market will resolve to the party that occupies the second finishing position after applying this ranking.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Swedish government, specifically the Swedish Election Authority (Valmyndigheten) (https://www.val.se/).

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is the official seat count from Valmyndigheten at [val.se](https://www.val.se/), with credible media reporting used first. I did not use any val.se data dated after 2026-09-10. As of the cutoff, no votes had been counted because election day is 2026-09-13.
- 2022 benchmark: SD 20.5% and 73 seats, M 19.1% and 68 seats, S 107 seats. [Wikipedia 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-10, nothing has settled the question. Voting takes place 2026-09-13, after forecasts close. The real contest for second is SD against M. S has led every poll by 6 to 13 points, and C, V, KD, MP and L poll at 9% or less.

## 3. Recent news and polls (newest first, fieldwork ending by 2026-09-10)
All poll figures are from [Wikipedia: opinion polling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Swedish_general_election). The table lists S / SD / M and the SD lead over M.

- What the polls show: SD led M in every poll from August through 2026-09-10. The leads ranged from 0.5 to 3.5 points and averaged about 2 points.
- In the final week the lead narrowed in some polls. Ipsos had it at 0.5 and Indikator at 1.5, while Verian still showed 2.3.
- Seats are allocated roughly in proportion to votes among parties above the 4% threshold. A lead of about 1 to 2 points works out to roughly 3 to 6 seats.

## 4. Base rates
- 2022: SD came second (73 seats) ahead of M (68). The final polls had SD and M close, and SD did better than some of them. [Wikipedia 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Swedish_general_election)
- 2018: SD finished third (62 seats) behind M (70). Before that election, several polls had shown SD in second or even first, so SD did worse than those polls suggested.
- In both cycles the SD-M gap at the actual election was only a few points. Final polls in Sweden typically miss individual parties by about 1 to 3 points, which is about the same size as the current SD lead. So the polling lead is real but not decisive.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Third-party trackers of the Polymarket "Sweden Parliamentary Election: 2nd Place" market showed SD as the clear favourite, at about 75% on one and 81¢ on another. A separate Moderate Party market showed about 17%. I could not confirm the exact snapshot dates, but these look like pre-election prices. [orrery SD](https://orrery.me/markets/will-the-sweden-democrats-sd-win-the-second-most-seats-in-the-2026-swedish-parliamentary-election), [orrery M](https://orrery.me/markets/will-the-moderate-party-m-win-the-second-most-seats-in-the-2026-swedish-parliamentary-election), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/502873), [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/elections/sweden-parliamentary-election-2nd-place)
- Polling aggregators: [PolitPro](https://politpro.eu/en/sweden) and [valprognos2026.se](https://valprognos2026.se/opinionsundersokningar). I could not get dated seat projections from either for 2026-09-10.
- I found no expert or academic seat forecast specifically for second place.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-12: the last polls (Novus, Demoskop, Infostat) and the final party-leader debates. Votes from undecided voters and late tactical voting within the right-wing bloc, between M and SD, could still change the order.
- 2026-09-13: election day, with SVT and Novus exit polls and a preliminary count on the night.
- About 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-17: Valmyndigheten counts the late-arriving and overseas votes, which usually shift a few seats.
- Around 2026-09-20 or later: final certification of seats by Valmyndigheten. The market resolves around 2026-09-28.

**Bottom line:** As of 2026-09-10, SD had a modest but steady polling lead over M for second place, and the market priced SD at about 75 to 80%. A late narrowing in some polls and the 2018 precedent, when SD came in below its polls, mean M is a real alternative. No other party is a realistic contender.
